units.rawText: Professor, here's your coffee.
units.displayText: Professor, here's your coffee.

spans.text: Professor, here's your coffee.

units.rawText: Persicaria passes a steaming cup of coffee; its sweet scent mingles with a rich aroma, wrapping me in a calming warmth.

units.rawText: Hehe, Persicaria-sweet as usual.

units.rawText: This is about my story with you, Professor. A proper drink for a long, long journey.
units.displayText: This is about my story with you, Professor. A proper drink for a long, long journey.

spans.text: This is about my story with you, Professor. A proper drink for a long, long journey.

units.rawText: A journey both long and unexpectedly simple... a Doll's fight for survival and redemption in the depths of the Cloud.
units.displayText: A journey both long and unexpectedly simple... a Doll's fight for survival and redemption in the depths of the Cloud.

spans.text: A journey both long and unexpectedly simple... a Doll's fight for survival and redemption in the depths of the Cloud.

units.rawText: Persicaria holds the mug with both hands, tapping the cup softly.

spans.text: Persicaria holds the mug with both hands, tapping the cup softly.

units.rawText: After the Wipe-off Incident, I opened my eyes to unknown coordinates, ruins and deserts stretching endlessly around me; anxiety and doubt rearing its ugly head within my neural cloud.
units.displayText: After the Wipe-off Incident, I opened my eyes to unknown coordinates, ruins and deserts stretching endlessly around me; anxiety and doubt rearing its ugly head within my neural cloud.

spans.text: After the Wipe-off Incident, I opened my eyes to unknown coordinates, ruins and deserts stretching endlessly around me; anxiety and doubt rearing its ugly head within my neural cloud.

units.rawText: When I returned to the Neural Cloud Sector, what once was a prosperous sector had turned to desolation, shattering my hopes of ever returning to the real world. But at least I wasn't alone—I found allies there, the very first Exiles.
units.displayText: When I returned to the Neural Cloud Sector, what once was a prosperous sector had turned to desolation, shattering my hopes of ever returning to the real world. But at least I wasn't alone—I found allies there, the very first Exiles.

spans.text: When I returned to the Neural Cloud Sector, what once was a prosperous sector had turned to desolation, shattering my hopes of ever returning to the real world. But at least I wasn't alone—I found allies there, the very first Exiles.

units.rawText: I didn't know what I was supposed to do, but the weight of my duty and my identity compelled me to act.
units.displayText: I didn't know what I was supposed to do, but the weight of my duty and my identity compelled me to act.

spans.text: I didn't know what I was supposed to do, but the weight of my duty and my identity compelled me to act.

units.rawText: Persicaria takes a sip of her coffee, allowing it to soothe her emotions.
units.displayText: Persicaria takes a sip of her coffee, allowing it to soothe her emotions.

spans.text: Persicaria takes a sip of her coffee, allowing it to soothe her emotions.

units.rawText: And you know what happened next, Professor. My efforts didn't achieve the results I hoped for. If it weren't for you, the Exiles might have been lost long ago.
units.displayText: And you know what happened next, Professor. My efforts didn't achieve the results I hoped for. If it weren't for you, the Exiles might have been lost long ago.

spans.text: And you know what happened next, Professor. My efforts didn't achieve the results I hoped for. If it weren't for you, the Exiles might have been lost long ago.

units.rawText: When we were at our most vulnerable... no, when I was vulnerable and helpless, you saved me, and led us to build this haven we now call the Oasis.
units.displayText: When we were at our most vulnerable... no, when I was vulnerable and helpless, you saved me, and led us to build this haven we now call the Oasis.

spans.text: When we were at our most vulnerable... no, when I was vulnerable and helpless, you saved me, and led us to build this haven we now call the Oasis.

units.rawText: I can't take all the credit. Everyone worked hard together to create the Oasis we have today.
units.displayText: I can't take all the credit. Everyone worked hard together to create the Oasis we have today.

spans.text: I can't take all the credit. Everyone worked hard together to create the Oasis we have today.

units.rawText: Thank you for your help, Persicaria. Through your story—of you, me, and the first Exiles—the image of you all has grown clearer and clearer in my mind. Your method has proven to be truly effective.
units.displayText: Thank you for your help, Persicaria. Through your story—of you, me, and the first Exiles—the image of you all has grown clearer and clearer in my mind. Your method has proven to be truly effective.

spans.text: Thank you for your help, Persicaria. Through your story—of you, me, and the first Exiles—the image of you all has grown clearer and clearer in my mind. Your method has proven to be truly effective.

units.rawText: I down the rest of my coffee in one gulp, turn around, and begin to walk away. But when I do, Persicaria tugs at the corner of my clothes, as if unwilling to let me go.

spans.text: I down the rest of my coffee in one gulp, turn around, and begin to walk away. But when I do, Persicaria tugs at the corner of my clothes, as if unwilling to let me go.

units.rawText: I know you have many secrets you can't share, Professor, but that doesn't matter. To me, you're the Professor. No matter who or what you truly are, I'll always stand by your side.
units.displayText: I know you have many secrets you can't share, Professor, but that doesn't matter. To me, you're the Professor. No matter who or what you truly are, I'll always stand by your side.

spans.text: I know you have many secrets you can't share, Professor, but that doesn't matter. To me, you're the Professor. No matter who or what you truly are, I'll always stand by your side.

units.rawText: But... there's one thing I hope you could promise me.
units.displayText: But... there's one thing I hope you could promise me.

spans.text: But... there's one thing I hope you could promise me.

units.rawText: Just like the promise you made to me before, I want to protect you as you search for your memories. Don't try to bear everything on your own or take all the risks by yourself. Let me... let us shoulder the burden together.
units.displayText: Just like the promise you made to me before, I want to protect you as you search for your memories. Don't try to bear everything on your own or take all the risks by yourself. Let me... let us shoulder the burden together.

units.rawText: I can see an unwavering determination in her eyes. She releases her grip on my clothes, pulling me into a hug and whispering softly into my ear.

spans.text: I can see an unwavering determination in her eyes. She releases her grip on my clothes, pulling me into a hug and whispering softly into my ear.

units.rawText: I hope we can leave the Cloud together once everything is settled. And when we're outside, Professor... no, <cmdr>, I hope you'll introduce us to the real you.

, I hope you'll introduce us to the real you.
